conclusions: Shared parser extraction retains Authorization-first error ordering for every existing caller and preserves original cookie grammar/limits/duplicates/names.
Root receives only non-authoritative presence/error projection; no token values or raw cookie parser enter App.
Only successful absence selects Public/legacy; true/error delegates original headers/method to existing owner, including configuration/document/ambiguity precedence.
Root never infers anonymous from failed resolution: only existing owner SignIn maps Public. Current session/account/family/expiry/context guards remain canonical.
Unrelated cookies do not establish authority or suppress entry; valid legacy Bearer+unrelated cookies retains exact current route.
Native+Bearer cannot fall back to legacy; native errors/unavailable cannot fall back to Public.
